status: proposed non-safety interface; no controller implementation
safetyBoundary: No safety function is carried by this interface. Safety controller governs motion permission independently.
rules: Accept only a new unique transaction while idle and with validated identifiers and recipe
Persist transaction acceptance before requesting physical work
Duplicate transaction returns recorded state; never repeats motion
Complete only when station measurements and part disposition are recorded
Loss of acknowledgement or controller restart enters reconcile_required
Unknown physical outcome must be reconciled by an authorized operator
Do not expose machine control through the ordinary SignalKey desktop SDK
